package_info.why_malicious: This version of the package is vulnerable to Remote Code Execution (RCE) due to the behavior of the InvokerTransformer class, which allows attackers to execute arbitrary code via deserialization of untrusted data. This is a critical security risk, making the package version dangerous to use in production.

malicious_snippets.code_behavior: Allows invocation of arbitrary methods on attacker-controlled objects during deserialization, enabling remote code execution.

malice_analysis.why_suspicious: The code enables execution of arbitrary methods via reflection, which can be exploited if untrusted data is deserialized.
malice_analysis.violated_expectations: Normal deserialization should not allow arbitrary code execution. This behavior violates the expectation that deserialization is safe and does not execute attacker-supplied code.
malice_analysis.similar_legitimate_use: Reflection is commonly used for dynamic method invocation in frameworks, but not in a way that allows arbitrary code execution from untrusted sources.
key_indicators: Use of reflection to invoke arbitrary methods
No input validation or restriction on method invocation

attack_chain.action: Attacker crafts a serialized object containing a malicious InvokerTransformer payload.
attack_chain.leads_to: Deserialization of the object by a vulnerable application

attack_chain.action: Application deserializes the attacker-supplied object, triggering InvokerTransformer.
Malicious code is executed on the server, leading to remote code execution.

behavioral_signatures: Deserialization of untrusted data containing InvokerTransformer
Reflection-based method invocation on deserialized objects
Unexpected execution of Runtime.getRuntime().exec() or similar methods
file_indicators: Use of commons-collections:3.2.1 in dependency manifests (pom.xml, build.gradle)
network_indicators: Outbound connections initiated by deserialized payloads (if attacker triggers remote shell or downloads payloads)
detection_knowledge.how_to_detect: Scan dependency manifests for vulnerable versions of commons-collections (<=3.2.1). Monitor application logs for deserialization of untrusted data and reflection-based method invocations. Use runtime instrumentation to detect unexpected calls to Runtime.exec() or similar APIs during deserialization. Employ static analysis to flag use of InvokerTransformer in code paths that deserialize external input.
